newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rupiah stable, trade low on election day.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rupiah stable, trade low on election day.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was stable against the dollar in thin trading late on Thursday as the country voted in general elections, dealers said.
They said activity was mainly generated from Singapore while most dealers in Jakarta took a half-day off to vote.
"The majority of the operators have left for home early. Many worked only for half a day," said a local bank dealer.
Spot rupiah was at 2,440.25/40.80 at 0900 GMT against a 2,439/40 open but little changed from the afternoon, dealers said.
Tomorrow rupiah closed at 2,440.25/40.80 while value today was not traded because there was no clearing by the central bank due to the elections.
Another dealer said liquidity seemed to be ample with overnight rupiah last seen at around eight percent.
Excess rupiah was placed into the central bank's overnight papers (SBI), which was offered at five percent by Bank Indonesia, the dealer said.
On Thursday, the central bank raised its intervention band by one point to 2,415/2,607 but lowered its conversion band by two points to 2,418/2,466.
